rice.optimal_soil: Clayey or alluvial soil with water retention capability
rice.description: Staple grain crop requiring abundant standing water during vegetative stages.

maize.optimal_soil: Well-drained deep loamy soils rich in organic matter
maize.description: Versatile crop used for grain, poultry feed, starch, and biofuel.

chickpea.optimal_soil: Sandy loam to clay loam; tolerates mild salinity
chickpea.description: High-protein pulse fixing atmospheric nitrogen to naturally enrich soil fertility.

kidneybeans.description: High-value culinary legume thriving in cool temperate climates.

pigeonpeas.optimal_soil: Deep well-drained loam or black cotton soil
pigeonpeas.description: Drought-hardy major pulse crop with deep taproots.

mothbeans.description: Extremely drought-tolerant pulse ideal for arid and semi-arid agro-climatic zones.

mungbean.description: Short-duration catch crop excellent for crop rotation and green manuring.

blackgram.optimal_soil: Heavy black soils or fertile loams
blackgram.description: Essential ingredient for traditional fermentations, rich in iron and protein.

lentil.description: Cool-season legume with high protein content and moderate drought resistance.

pomegranate.description: High-return commercial horticultural fruit with export potential.

banana.optimal_soil: Rich, loamy soil with high organic matter
banana.description: Heavy nutrient feeder requiring consistent moisture and protection from severe frost.

mango.optimal_soil: Deep, well-drained alluvial or red loams
mango.description: King of fruits; flourishes in tropical and subtropical regions.

grapes.optimal_soil: Well-drained sandy loam or gravelly soil
grapes.description: Commercial viticulture crop with high potassium and phosphorus requirements.

watermelon.optimal_soil: Sandy loam rich in organic matter
watermelon.description: Fast-growing warm season cucurbit that requires warm sunshine and dry ripening period.

muskmelon.description: High-sweetness commercial melon demanding warm temperature during maturation.

apple.optimal_soil: Loamy soil rich in organic matter with excellent drainage
apple.description: Deciduous temperate fruit requiring substantial winter chilling hours.

orange.optimal_soil: Light loam or sandy loam with good drainage
orange.description: Subtropical citrus crop sensitive to waterlogging and soil alkalinity.

papaya.optimal_soil: Well-drained rich alluvial or sandy loam
papaya.description: Quick yielding tropical fruit; strictly cannot tolerate standing stagnant water.

coconut.optimal_soil: Coastal sandy or red alluvial loams
coconut.description: Multi-utility coastal plantation palm requiring warm, humid tropical conditions.

cotton.description: Major commercial fiber crop requiring high nitrogen and sunny, frost-free weather.

jute.optimal_soil: New alluvial silt soils of river basins
jute.description: Golden fiber crop requiring high heat and humidity during vegetative stage.

coffee.description: Shade-loving hill plantation crop grown under canopy in elevated regions.

Urea.best_for: Rapid vegetative foliage, chlorophyll synthesis, and leafy stem growth.
Urea.application_method: Split application (1/3 basal at sowing, 2/3 top-dressed at tillering/knee-high stage).
Urea.organic_alternative: Farmyard Manure (FYM), Vermicompost, or Mustard Seed Cake.

DAP.best_for: Vigorous root establishment, early tillering, and seedling vigor.
DAP.application_method: Apply as a basal dose placed 3-5 cm below and to the side of seed placement.
DAP.organic_alternative: Steamed Bone Meal, Rock Phosphate enriched with PSB (Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria).

10-26-26.best_for: Fruit formation, tuber bulking, disease resistance, and grain weight.
10-26-26.application_method: Basal dose or early top-dressing before flowering/heading stage.
10-26-26.organic_alternative: Wood ash combined with enriched compost and Potassium Solubilizing Biofertilizers (KSB).

14-35-14.nutrient_focus: High Phosphorus with balanced Nitrogen and Potash
14-35-14.best_for: Legumes, oilseeds, and root development in heavy soils.
14-35-14.application_method: Basal application at land preparation or sowing time.
14-35-14.organic_alternative: Composted poultry manure mixed with rock phosphate.

28-28-0.best_for: Fast-growing cereal crops in potassium-rich soils.
28-28-0.application_method: Split dose: half at final ploughing and half at vegetative surge.
28-28-0.organic_alternative: Biogas slurry combined with Azotobacter and vermicompost.

17-17-17.best_for: Commercial horticulture, vegetables, sugarcane, and overall plant health.
17-17-17.application_method: Can be applied in 2-3 split applications across critical growth stages.
17-17-17.organic_alternative: Well-aged cow dung compost enriched with Panchagavya and bio-NPK consortia.

20-20.best_for: Oilseeds (mustard, groundnut, soybean) and pulses requiring sulphur for oil/protein synthesis.
20-20.application_method: Broadcast or drill as basal dose.
20-20.organic_alternative: Gypsum mixed with organic compost and neem cake.
